Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::chooseSupplier(supplierID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		supplier: Set(Supplier) = Supplier.allInstance()->any(s|s.Id = SupplierID)
	precondition:
		Supplier.allInstance()->excludes(supplier) = false and
		CurrentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		Supplier.allInstance()->includes(supplier) and
		CurrentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentOrderProduct.Supplier = supplier
}
